findings.detail: Hero.astro is outside WI-1's originally-declared files_scope but was edited (adding phoneCopy/boardCopy props). This is a minimal, necessary, well-documented pass-through: PhoneMockup/DispatchBoard render inside Hero's .stage, so threading resolved copy props through Hero is the only way to reach them without importing t() into the mockup layer (which the assignment forbids). Accepted as correct; noting only that files_scope should have listed Hero. Same applies to Origin.astro/routes.ts, folded in via the origin extension.
findings.suggestion: No change needed; conductor should note the scope additions (Hero.astro, Origin.astro, routes.ts) when reconciling files_touched vs the original files_scope.

summary: WI-1 (incl. the origin extension) is correct and complete; no blockers. All mockup components — PhoneMockup, DispatchBoard, MiniMockup, TinyPhone, AND the #origin fixed-route map (Origin.astro) — resolve every localizable label via props threaded from HomeSections (locale-resolved with t()); NO t() import in any mockup/Origin component (verified). Localize-vs-literal classification matches the assignment table, including the intended split where brand-route 'Kolín, nádraží → centrum' and origin 'Nádraží → centrum' localize while phone pickupPlace 'Kolín, nádraží' and the town→town origin row 'Kutná Hora → Kolín' stay literal proper nouns. Parity is 161/161 keys; the 13 new keys (12 mock.* + origin.route1) plus the reused-and-now-wired origin.anywhereKH are present in both cs.json and en.json; cs values are byte-identical to the original data-module literals (origin.route1 confirmed byte-equal to the old routes.ts string; NBSP retained on literal money incl. '31 250 Kč'; '·'/'→' preserved; detail strings kept their original regular spaces); en values are genuine translations. The prior MAJOR out-of-scope finding (Origin/routes.ts shipping Czech on /en/) is now RESOLVED in-scope by the origin extension: dist/en/index.html shows 0 hits for 'Nádraží'/'Kdekoli po Kutné Hoře'/'centrum' and renders 'Station → centre' + 'Anywhere in Kutná Hora'; dist cs unchanged (no regression). The only residual Czech in dist/en is 'Zavolat' inside FAQPage JSON-LD (faq.a4), genuinely WI-3 scope. blocks_merge=false.
